races.title: Ladbrokes 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CRYSTAL ISLAND marked himself down as potentially smart when winning each of his 2 starts in novice hurdles last season (including here) and every inch an exciting prospect now his attentions switch to larger obstacles, he makes plenty of appeal. Fellow point winner Gee Force Flyer went the right way in 5 starts over hurdles himself last season and may well offer up chief resistance. CRYSTAL ISLAND (IRE) GEE FORCE FLYER (IRE) ETNA BIANCO (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Crystal Island (4/5), Gee Force Flyer (4/5), Etna Bianco (1/1)

races.title: Ascot Promoting Safer Gambling Week 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CURRENT EDITION suffered a second narrow reverse from 3 starts over hurdles at Huntingdon 23 days ago, the steadily-run nature of the race not bringing his stamina sufficiently into play. He clearly has a race like this within his grasp and edges preference over No Way Jay , who clearly benefited from the return to a right-handed track when second on hurdles debut here last month. Diamonds And Denim and Jet Bay are a couple of interesting hurdling newcomers to note, too. CURRENT EDITION (IRE) NO WAY JAY (IRE) DIAMONDS AND DENIM (IRE)

races.title: Bet With Ascot Donation Box Winners 'Introductory' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PUSH THE LIMIT failed to land the odds on his hurdles debut but Dan Skelton's 4-y-o should prove capable of much better given his smart Flat form. Spanish Stroll showed a good turn of foot when scoring on his hurdles bow and is most feared, whilst Without Burlington made a good impression at Worcester in the summer and also merits consideration after a break. PUSH THE LIMIT (FR) SPANISH STROLL WITHOUT BURLINGTON
races.bettingForecast: Push The Limit (13/8), Premiere Ligne (9/4), Spanish Stroll (4/1), Without Burlington (6/1), Prometeo (16/1), Expressionless (25/1)

races.title: Join Ladbrokes Bet 5 Pound Get 30 Pound Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: JET TO VEGAS pulled clear with an unexposed rival here 3 weeks ago and the Russell & Scudamore-trained gelding can continue his run of good form to score for the second time this autumn. Crebilly has proved most reliable this season and has to be respected after a small rise for his Wetherby win, while Somespring Special should be all the better for her recent outing. JET TO VEGAS (IRE) CREBILLY (IRE) SOMESPRING SPECIAL (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Fringill Dike (15/8), Crebilly (3/1), Jet To Vegas (10/3), Western Knight (8/1), Somespring Special (8/1), Thecompanysergeant (12/1)

races.title: Ascot Shared Ownership Weekend Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE ran a cracker when third in a better race over C&D last time, finishing ahead of 3 of today's rivals, and he gets the nod in a tricky handicap. Recent Newton Abbot winner Intellotto is a serious danger if repeating that effort, with Ooh Betty potentially interesting back in calmer waters. MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE (IRE) INTELLOTTO (IRE) OOH BETTY (IRE)

races.title: Ladbrokes 'Get Your Free Racing Bet Today' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FEVER DREAM and Gasmani appeal most, with Christian Williams' charge fancied to make it 3 wins from his last 5 starts over fences. Muskoka and Ideal Des Bordes both come with risks attached, so likely improver Draco Malfoy gets the nod as best of the rest. FEVER DREAM (IRE) GASMANI (IRE) DRACO MALFOY (IRE)

races.title: Bet Responsibly With Ladbrokes Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: POWER STEERING made a promising start when just failing in a Ballinrobe bumper for Sean Thomas Doyle in May and seems sure to improve having been purchased by shrewd connections for a 6-figure sum. He's preferred to standard-setter Dennis's Honor , who ran to a good level when second at Cheltenham last month but perhaps benefited a little from how the race unfolded. Bielle Biarrey still held every chance when falling on his sole outing in Irish points and is an interesting Rules newcomer. POWER STEERING (IRE) DENNIS'S HONOR BIELLE BIARREY (FR)
